data.one_liner: Circular bottom navigation bar with animated circular icons
data.what_it_does: Provides a bottom navigation bar where each tab is a circular icon that can be animated and customized. It supports RTL, gradients, shadows, and a controller for programmatic tab changes.
use_when: You need a visually distinct bottom navigation bar with circular icons
You want to animate tab changes or control them programmatically
You need RTL support for internationalization
avoid_when: You prefer a standard Material BottomNavigationBar
You need deep navigation routing or complex nested navigation
strengths: Controller allows changing tabs without rebuilding the widget
Simple API, no code generation required
weaknesses: No built‑in routing or navigation logic
No support for badges or notification dots
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import the package. No special permissions or build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full routing and navigation management for Flutter apps
